panels.title: Mining evidence · all current candidate endpoints
panels.description:
One row per observed VM, fixed IP, destination port and evidence tier at range end. Port, reply and persistence observations are mining evidence, not proof of mining. A host with incomplete observation is excluded from current findings and counted in the coverage indicators.

CPU is a five-minute mean requiring at least three samples and a current CPU measurement. Missing CPU stays Unavailable; CPU is context, not a threat score. Source age shows the observation source age, not when the endpoint was first seen. Remote destination IP and exact first-seen time are not exported.

An empty table can mean no matching observations or unavailable telemetry; check coverage. All eligible rows are returned. Instance and project links use UUIDs even when names repeat; full UUIDs are available in Inspect → Data and links.

panels.description: Distinct running instance UUIDs with active matches at range end, counted separately for each usable list. Only fresh libvirt/conntrack observations from reachable exporters are included. Zero requires observed per-instance metrics for that list; missing or disabled data stays absent. One instance may appear in multiple lists. Partial host or instance coverage can undercount; check the coverage panels. A list match does not prove compromise.

New contact matches per second over the rolling $__rate_interval window, summed across both configured traffic directions and selected instances. Only running instances with fresh, reachable collection and usable lists contribute at each evaluation. List overlap is preserved: these are per-list events, not globally unique remote connections. Missing data leaves gaps. A window can straddle an earlier collection outage; the rate uses available counter samples and does not prove uninterrupted coverage.

list.description: Choose which series appear in Top N graphs. Max in range (default) uses the highest plotted ranking value; Mean in range uses its average. Last is the right-edge value and remains unavailable for ended series; Max is the highest plotted sample.
